column1: # G7 phase 6: the path-addressed diff (the `diff` MCP tool)
# object {right, at?} and expect is {changes, same} plus `codes`
# when a document does not stand up. Messages are excluded.
# Deterministic canon is what makes this possible without phantom
# noise: two documents that MEAN the same thing canon the same way,
# so reordering keys is not a change (diff-key-order-is-not-a-change).
# The text compared is the HASH FORM, not the plain canon: canon
# drops closedness and the type/hide marks, so a canon diff would
# call close({a:1}) and {a:1} identical (diff-closedness). A false
# Bags of the same kind recurse, so the report is path-addressed
# rather than one line saying the document changed; a bag's SPREAD is
# part of what it means and diffs at the `&` pseudo-key, as its
# closedness and marks do at `&closed`, `&type` and `&hide`.
# WHETHER a change is BREAKING is G3's question, not this one.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).
